channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Anthony Edwards | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Anthony Edwards from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Chris Finch on Anthony Edwards
item.description:
Finch said of adding Ball.

“Always come in smiling. He and Anthony have a shared quality: they're really hard to stay mad at. And they do some things that you want to get mad at. And they have a reflective joy... We refered to ourselves as a moody team in the last couple of years at times and it's probably gotten in our way. We've traded moodiness for giddiness.”

Chris Finch on Anthony Edwards, Oct 12, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Chris Finch on LaMelo Ball, Anthony Edwards
item.description:
“Anthony loves to root for his teammates; he's a fun-spirited but competitive guy, and we felt (LaMelo) might help lighten the mood around Anthony a little bit. We also felt like Anthony's competitive seriousness could also help LaMelo.”

Chris Finch on LaMelo Ball, Anthony Edwards, Oct 6, 2026. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Naz Reid on Brandon Miller, Anthony Edwards
item.description:
Naz Reid on Brandon Miller:

“His patience. His consistency. I think his leadership is starting to kinda form, and that’s big in a younger guy. I was with Ant [Edwards], who I started to see his shift and his change of going from his third year to his fourth year, and I think Brandon can do the same. I think I’m coming here to help out. This is his team, him and Kon [Knueppel], and I’m here to help in a big way. But I think the growth for him would be to, like I said, lead on and off the court and just be consistent and do the things that you preach.”

Naz Reid on Brandon Miller, Anthony Edwards, Oct 5, 2026. Source: TalkBasket.

item.title: Tim Connelly on Anthony Edwards
item.description:
Tim Connelly:

“Anthony's best chance to be the best player in the world is to be the best two-way player in the world. His competition is so good and so talented to be in that mix of the top four or five guys to be an MVP candidate. I think he'd be the first to tell you at times last year, and some of it was our fault, we put him in positions where he had to do so much offensively. We think a lot of the ball-handling stuff will be out of his hands now with more traditional point guards next to him. But he's got to be a two-way player. He's got to be a lead on both ends.”

Tim Connelly on Anthony Edwards, Sep 30, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Matt Lloyd on Alonzo Gee, Chris Finch, Tim Connelly, Anthony Edwards, Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
Matt Lloyd:

“The opportunity came up to sign Jonathan Kuminga, which again was the product of many, many phone calls and a lot of time investment. My wife asked me at one point, how many times has he called you? She was referencing Jonathan Kuminga's agent. How many times have you been on the phone with him since the middle of July? So I said, okay, I will look, and we went through my phone and we had 94 phone calls between July 15th to the day we signed Jonathan. Anthony Edwards was really instrumental in recruiting him to come here. We had several conversations with him, his representatives, and from Chris Finch to Tim Connelly to Alonzo Gee, who is on our staff, everything just came together.”

Matt Lloyd on Alonzo Gee, Chris Finch, Tim Connelly, Anthony Edwards, Jonathan Kuminga, Sep 19, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Tyrese Maxey on Anthony Edwards
item.description:
Tyrese Maxey:

“I was going to class every single day. My biggest thing was I want to have a great freshman year. My mom was big on school, I'm big on academics, so I was going to class every single day. We played against Anthony Edwards, we knew he was going to be a number one pick. I had 19 points, 8 rebounds, 8 assists, 4 blocks, 2 steals. The next day we had class at 8 o'clock in the morning and I think it snowed.”

Tyrese Maxey on Anthony Edwards, Sep 11, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Chris Finch on Anthony Edwards
item.description:
Chris Finch on Anthony Edwards shaking hands early with Spurs:

“I think it’s probably one of the more misunderstood things that actually has happened… I saw him walk down there and then when he came back, I said, “You’re not going to the locker room, are you?”

Chris Finch on Anthony Edwards, Aug 6, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Chris Finch on LaMelo Ball, Kon Knueppel, Anthony Edwards
item.description:
Chris Finch on Anthony Edwards playing point guard and Wolves picking up LaMelo Ball:

“In the playoffs it was just double team after double team. We got to get him back to his natural position off the ball. We didn’t create enough catch and shoot threes for him and when you look at the numbers with LaMelo on the floor with his teammates and the efficiency and the production, I mean Kon Knueppel shot 7% higher from the three-point line with LaMelo on the floor than he did without. I mean that’s a massive stat for a great shooter and that’s a big bump for a great shooter.”

Chris Finch on LaMelo Ball, Kon Knueppel, Anthony Edwards, Aug 6, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Darren Wolfson on Anthony Edwards, Rudy Gobert
item.description:
Darren Wolfson on Wolves trading Rudy Gobert:

“Put it this way, the way it's been laid out to me, outside of Anthony Edwards, just about everything is legitimately on the table.”

Darren Wolfson on Anthony Edwards, Rudy Gobert, Jun 2, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Devin Vassell on Anthony Edwards
item.description:
Devin Vassell on Anthony Edwards’ potential adjustments:

“Play fast, try and beat those doubles, go away from them. We'll give him different looks so it's not predictable. But, I mean, he's a special player, so we got to give him different look so he doesn’t get used to it.”

Devin Vassell on Anthony Edwards, May 8, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jaden McDaniels on Anthony Edwards
item.description:
Jaden McDaniels on talking to Anthony Edwards at half time:

“I just told him we’re going to win for him and we’ll handle business… I didn’t even ask him what happened or nothing, I just told him we were going to win the game”

Jaden McDaniels on Anthony Edwards, Apr 26, 2026. Source: reddit.

item.title: Chris Finch on Anthony Edwards
item.description:
Jon Krawczynski:Chris Finch on Anthony Edwards' knee:

“I think it's definitely still something that we're managing and he's managing but all signs are pointing that it is getting better.”

Chris Finch on Anthony Edwards, Apr 24, 2026. Source: Twitter @JonKrawczynski.

item.title: Paul Pierce on James Posey, Julius Randle, Anthony Edwards
item.description:
Paul Pierce says the Timberwolves lack leadership:

“Not to say that Anthony Edwards is not a leader or Julius Randle. But I also think when you trying to win a championship there is got to be somebody in that locker room that everybody respects that’s been to the promised land, to help you. Like, for us we had veterans Ray,KG, myself but we didn’t win a championship. Having James Posey in that locker room who won a championship was important for us. And I think that’s the one piece they’re missing a guy that’s been around the block, that’s like look guys it’s playoffs time and lock in and practice habits right now, a lot of little things.”

Paul Pierce on James Posey, Julius Randle, Anthony Edwards, Mar 16, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Draymond Green on Andrew Bogut, Anthony Edwards
item.description:
MrBuckBuck:Draymond Green on Memphis hotel:

“[Anthony Edwards] is pretty blunt about it, but yeah. We stopped staying there because their sprinklers just went off for no reason in the room... Drenched all of [Andrew] Bogut's stuff, and they didn’t want to do anything about it. So, it’s been an issue.”

Draymond Green on Andrew Bogut, Anthony Edwards, Feb 23, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Chris Finch on Anthony Edwards
item.description:
MrBuckBuck: Darren Wolfson: Kevin Durant vetoed a trade to the Timberwolves last summer because he didn't want to play under Chris Finch:

“I don't have all the inner-workings of this, but my understanding is KD had trepidation playing for Chris Finch... Superstars want to play with Anthony Edwards.”

Chris Finch on Anthony Edwards, Feb 3, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Michael Jordan on Anthony Edwards
item.description:
Michael Jordan:

“I had a conversation this summer with a high executive at Minnesota and he was talking about Anthony Edwards. I heard during the course of the year that they were double teaming (him).He didn't know how to deal with the double team...those are the types of conversations I try to have when players seek that information”

Michael Jordan on Anthony Edwards, Dec 3, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tim Connelly on Anthony Edwards
item.description:
Tim Connelly on Anthony Edwards:

“We think he’s not only a great player but can be one of the greatest of players of all time.”

Tim Connelly on Anthony Edwards, Sep 29, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Nigel Hayes-Davis on Anthony Edwards
item.description:
“Delusional confidence is the greatest thing. I learned that last year and I saw that with Anthony Edwards,”

Nigel Hayes-Davis on Anthony Edwards, Sep 28, 2025. Source: Arizona's Sports Page.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Free throws, Anthony Edwards
item.description:
Mark Cuban:

“Watch Anthony Edwards when he takes a free throw shot. Watch when he shoots his free throws. Every single time he steps over the line - every time. And if you remember back in the day, I used to send in tapes on Shaq... We sent in the Shaq and they started calling it, and he had to fix his free throws. Anthony Edwards, we had a game against them, where they were up like 93-92, with a few seconds left. He goes two feet; you know, he steps over the line and then the ball crosses... goes into the basket. I'm like, this is the easiest call for a referee. Just watch to see if he steps over the line, and they refused to call it.. Tell the league, (but they) refuse to call it.”

Mark Cuban on Free throws, Anthony Edwards, Sep 12, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Alex Rodriguez on Tim Connelly, Anthony Edwards
item.description:
“When you talk about Tim Connelly, coach Finch and Anthony Edwards, especially because of Anthony’s age, having those three together is a great kind of foundation.”

Alex Rodriguez on Tim Connelly, Anthony Edwards, Jun 24, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Julius Randle on Anthony Edwards
item.description:
“This is the most meaningful basketball I’ve played in my career, and from how the organization has made me feel from the front office, my teammates, and playing with Ant (Anthony Edwards) as our leader, I loveit. There’s a lot to be excited about. Having the ability to compete for a championship is everything I could ask for at this point in my career.”

Julius Randle on Anthony Edwards, Jun 4, 2025. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Tim Connelly on Anthony Edwards
item.description:
Michael Scotto:Minnesota Timberwolves President Tim Connelly on Anthony Edwards:

“The sky is the limit. We think he’s going to be one of the best players of all time,and we think he’s on that track.”

Tim Connelly on Anthony Edwards, Jun 2, 2025. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Rudy Gobert on Anthony Edwards
item.description:
Rudy Gobert on Anthony Edwards’ Game 4 performance:

“I thought he was great …A lot of people think basketball is just about scoring 30 every night, it’s not true.”

Rudy Gobert on Anthony Edwards, May 28, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Anthony Edwards
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Anthony Edwards’ growth in the playoffs:

“He’s a great player and has done a great job there. I think it speaks to how young he was when he came in the league and was in this role right off the bat…the amount of experience he’s amassed at 23 is nuts”

Mark Daigneault on Anthony Edwards, May 20, 2025. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Chris Finch on Anthony Edwards
item.description:
Timberwolves coachChris Finch on Anthony Edwards:

“You’re the leader of the team, and you’ve got to come out and set the tone. If your shot’s not going, you still have to carry the energy.”

Chris Finch on Anthony Edwards, May 7, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Donte DiVincenzo on Anthony Edwards
item.description:
Chris Hine:Donte DiVincenzo on Anthony Edwards:

“Throughout the entire season whether in the storms of ups & downs & different guys in the lineup & trying to figure it out & get guys comfortable -- when it comes winning time the dude knows how to win. That's flat out what it comes down to.”

Donte DiVincenzo on Anthony Edwards, Apr 27, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Chris Finch on Anthony Edwards
item.description:
Chris Finch on Anthony Edwards:

“We need him to be aggressive. We need him to be Ant. He loves these moments. This is what he lives for.”

Chris Finch on Anthony Edwards, Apr 19, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Magic Johnson on Ja Morant, Anthony Edwards
item.description:
Magic Johnson:

“Anthony Edwards is the most exciting player to watch in the NBA. If you look at him and you look at Ja Morant, they’re probably the two. And then, of course, Kyrie. Those three can just put on a show. You watch them, and you’re like, ‘Whoo!’ But when Anthony Edwards said this summer, ‘Oh, nobody’s ever been as athletic as me in this league. Nobody could jump like me,’ I was like, ‘Whoa, whoa, whoa. What are you talking about?’”

Magic Johnson on Ja Morant, Anthony Edwards, Mar 17, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Bradley Beal on Anthony Edwards
item.description:
Bradley Beal on his flagrant foul on Anthony Edwards:

“We not about to turn us into a highlight reel. Like, we've already seen enough highlights from them tonight. I was just making an aggressive play and just letting him know, like, we're not doing that. And he respected it”

Bradley Beal on Anthony Edwards, Mar 3, 2025. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: LeBron James on Anthony Edwards
item.description:
“He (Anthony Edwards) don't want, I obviously didn't ask for it. But under there's responsibility for me. Not only to my family, my friends, my community, and whoever that's gonna follow my journey throughout my career,”

LeBron James on Anthony Edwards, Feb 28, 2025. Source: BasketNews.
